NVIDIA Packages OpenShell Into a Full-Stack Safe-Agent Reference Architecture at GTC Berlin

At GTC Berlin on Oct. 21, 2026, NVIDIA put OpenShell, Vera Rubin, Vera CPUs and BlueField-4 Sentry into one reference architecture for building, containing and enforcing safe AI agents — and said it is available now.
